info.name: ContactForm
info.title: Contact form
info.description: Public forms backed by content types, persistent submissions, and pluggable notification channels.
info.author: Kami team

title.title: Form title
title.description: Optional heading displayed above this form.

content_type.title: Content type
content_type.description: Content type whose fields define this form.

recipient_override.title: Recipient override
recipient_override.description: Optional comma-separated email recipients for this form instance.

subject_override.title: Subject override
subject_override.description: Optional email subject for this form instance.

rate_limit_count.title: Rate limit
rate_limit_count.description: Maximum accepted submissions from one IP or client context during the configured window.

notification_channels.title: Notification channels
notification_channels.description: Channels used to deliver new submissions.

recipient.title: Email recipients
recipient.description: One or more email addresses separated by commas.

save_item.title: Save content item
save_item.description: Store the submitted form as a content item in addition to the immutable submission snapshot.
